values.note: 2026: $29 a night for a single site (double site $58). One vehicle included; each extra vehicle $8 a night.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234509/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-01 to 2026-10-10 and 2027-04-30 to 2027-10-09: 'PeakSTANDARD NONELECTRIC': 29) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/stove-prairie-campground ('Single Site: $29 per night / Double Site: $58 per night') + recreation.gov notice ('Any additional vehicles will be charged $8.00 per vehicle per night'), read 2026-10-28

hookups.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 234509 (every RV site typed STANDARD NONELECTRIC) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234509 (notice 'No RV water connections are available.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Nine sites: five back-in drive-in sites for RVs and trailers (catalogued at 35-40 ft) and four walk-in tent sites. FS page: parking spurs 30-55 ft; the forest's status table: max spur 30 ft.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/stove-prairie-campground ('There are nine sites including four walk-in tent sites'; 'The parking length ranges from 30 to 55 feet') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Stove Prairie: Sites '9', Max Spur '30''') + recreation.gov catalog for 234509 (5 STANDARD NONELECTRIC sites, Max Vehicle Length 35 and 40, Driveway Entry Back-In; 4 WALK TO tent sites), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Drinking water in peak season only; filling RV tanks at the hydrants is not allowed. Bear lockers at the tent sites; firewood sold by the host.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/stove-prairie-campground (Restrooms 'Vault toilet(s)'; Water 'Potable water is available at this site.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234509 (amenities 'Accessible Vault Toilets', 'Drinking Water (peak season)'; notices 'Come with your RV/trailer water tank filled. Filling at campground hydrants ... is not allowed', 'All campsites with a tent pad have a bear locker'), read 2026-10-28

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Canyon Lakes Ranger District Campground Status: Stove Prairie, Operating Season 'May 1 - Oct 11'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Reservations close 4 days before arrival; a site not occupied within 26 hours of the start goes to walk-ups. One drive-in site is first-come, and sites are first-come outside the reservation season. Check in with the host at Ansel Watrous before setting up.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234509 (rules reservationCutOff 4 'day(s) prior to arrival'; notices 'Sites may be available on a first-come, first-served basis before and after the reservation season', 'All campsites must be occupied within 26 hours ...', 'Check-in with host at Ansel Watrous prior to setting up camp') + /rates (2026 Peak Season 2026-05-01 to 2026-10-10) + catalog (site 001 not reservable) + FS page ('Sites are available on a first-come first-serve basis outside the reservation season'), read 2026-10-28

note: Canyon Lakes RD, Poudre Canyon (Arapaho-Roosevelt NF), 26 miles northwest of Fort Collins on CO-14, on a bend of the Cache la Poudre River among ponderosa pine and aspen. --Claude
summary: rec.gov API + rates + per-site catalog + FS page + ARP status table: confirmed $29, 9 sites, max 40 ft, no electric, reservable on recreation.gov. Added no water hookups, vault toilets + potable water, season May 1-Oct 11 (2026), reservation season May 1-Oct 10, fcfs some_sites, back-in only. Note trimmed of count/length/booking restatements.
flags: Waterfront (stored riverfront): supported. FS/rec.gov: 'situated ... on the banks of the Cache la Poudre River'. On Esri imagery the loop sits on a peninsula inside a river bend; the drive-in sites (001/002 east end, 007-009 west end) are about 25-40 m from the channel through a fringe of trees, the walk-in tent sites closer on the north side.

Max length conflict: FS page 'parking length ranges from 30 to 55 feet'; ARP status table 'Max Spur 30''; recreation.gov catalog 35 ft (1 site) and 40 ft (4 sites). Kept 40 from the catalog. All fit 23 ft.
